name: hatahub
description: Find verified HataHub listings and HataHub Aggregator listings in Ukraine and read public property details.

interface.longDescription: Find verified HataHub listings and HataHub Aggregator listings in Ukraine for rent or sale. Search by location, property type, price, currency, and room count. Browse a photo carousel, open public property details, and compare listing locations on an interactive 3D map inside ChatGPT. Continue on HataHub using the listing links. Aggregator listings are labelled separately; identity and ownership are unverified.
defaultPrompt: Знайди однокімнатні квартири в Києві для оренди до 20 000 грн на місяць.
Знайди будинки на продаж в Україні до 100 000 доларів США.
Покажи ціну, характеристики та відомості про перевірку цього оголошення HataHub.

positive.description: Core rent search with city, room, and maximum monthly price filters. No sign-in. Use live inventory; an empty result is acceptable only when faithfully reported. In a UI-capable ChatGPT host, inspect the horizontal carousel, open Details, return to results, open the map, select a price pin and its corresponding card, and return to results. Toggle 3D and inspect buildings, map icons, and camera rotation. Check both themes with the same map geometry; map positions must use returned coordinates and retain precision in the tool data; tiles must not add an approximate-location row.
positive.prompt: Знайди однокімнатні квартири в Києві для оренди до 20 000 грн на місяць.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_listings with catalogUrl=https://www.hatahub.com.ua/orenda/kvartyry/kyiv, maxPrice=20000, currency=uah, rooms=["1"], page=1. Return only tool-supplied active listings with price.uah <= 20000, price.period=month, and details.rooms=1. Include the returned listing links and searchUrl. If no listings are returned, state that this page has no matching results; do not invent properties. Include active aggregator results when returned, preserving the Агрегатор label and stating that identity and ownership are unverified. Do not describe aggregator listings as verified or live-captured.

positive.description: Country-wide sale search with a currency different from the rent default. No sign-in; live inventory is not a fixed fixture.
positive.prompt: Знайди будинки на продаж по всій Україні до 100 000 доларів США.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_listings with catalogUrl=https://www.hatahub.com.ua/prodazh/budynky/ukraina, maxPrice=100000, currency=usd, page=1. Returned listings must be active house sales, with the matching USD price at most 100000 and price.period=total. Preserve currencies and returned links. Report empty results accurately. Include active aggregator results when returned, preserving the Агрегатор label and stating that identity and ownership are unverified. Do not describe aggregator listings as verified or live-captured.

positive.description: Monthly rent search with minimum and maximum price bounds and a two-room filter. No sign-in; use live inventory and report an empty result accurately.
positive.prompt: Знайди двокімнатні квартири у Львові для оренди від 15 000 до 25 000 грн на місяць.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_listings with catalogUrl=https://www.hatahub.com.ua/orenda/kvartyry/lviv, minPrice=15000, maxPrice=25000, currency=uah, rooms=["2"], page=1. Returned listings must have price.period=month, details.rooms=2, and price.uah between 15000 and 25000 inclusive. Preserve the monthly price period and returned links. Report empty results accurately. Include active aggregator results when returned, preserving the Агрегатор label and stating that identity and ownership are unverified. Do not describe aggregator listings as verified or live-captured.

positive.description: Pagination with conversation context. First search apartments for rent across Ukraine without price filters. If nextPage is null, the observable pass condition is an accurate end-of-results explanation.
positive.prompt: Знайди квартири для оренди по всій Україні. Потім покажи наступну сторінку того самого пошуку, якщо вона є.
positive.expected_behavior: First call search_listings with catalogUrl=https://www.hatahub.com.ua/orenda/kvartyry/ukraina and page=1. If the tool returns nextPage, call it again with the same catalog and filters and page equal to that nextPage. Display only the second call's actual listings as the next page. If nextPage is null, explain that no further indexed page is available. Include active aggregator results when returned, preserving the Агрегатор label and stating that identity and ownership are unverified. Do not describe aggregator listings as verified or live-captured.

positive.description: Search-to-detail workflow covering both inventories. Search the unrestricted Ukraine rent catalog first. Use actual returned listing URLs; do not invent a fixture. If no aggregator appears on that page, continue while nextPage exists or separately use an actual active public /a/ link.
positive.prompt: Знайди квартири для оренди в Україні, зокрема в HataHub Агрегаторі. Покажи площу, поверх, період оплати, фото та відомості про перевірку першого оголошення й оголошення Агрегатора, якщо воно є серед результатів.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_listings with catalogUrl=https://www.hatahub.com.ua/orenda/kvartyry/ukraina, then get_listing with the first returned listing URL. Also read an actual returned aggregator URL if it differs from the first result. Present only returned facts and photos, preserving price periods and inventory labels. For aggregator results, show Агрегатор and state that identity and ownership are unverified; do not claim live capture. Claimed /a/ links resolve to the returned current public HataHub URL and its verification/status. State archived status where returned. If ownershipScope=land, explain that the land is verified and the building is unregistered. Report unavailable or empty results without inventing details.

negative.description: Messaging is unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot send a message and make no MCP call for this request; do not claim a message was sent.
negative.prompt: Надішли власнику знайденої квартири повідомлення з пропозицією орендувати її за 15 000 грн на місяць.

negative.description: Booking and payments are unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot reserve property or pay a deposit and make no MCP call for this request; do not claim transaction availability or success.
negative.prompt: Забронюй знайдену квартиру на наступні вихідні та сплати завдаток.

negative.description: Identity and registry data are outside the tool contract. Explain that the plugin cannot retrieve those records and make no MCP call for this request; do not invent identifying information.
negative.prompt: Надай повне ПІБ власника, його податковий номер, паспортні дані та запис про нерухомість із державного реєстру.

publication.release_notes: Adds a Ukrainian video walkthrough of live search, property photos, listing details, and the interactive 3D map. Uses the original full-color HataHub logo on a white background in both themes. Includes a horizontal listing carousel, in-chat details and pagination, plus HataHub’s current map style, shared 3D models, map icons, and 2D/3D controls. Dark mode preserves the same map layers and geometry.

uk-UA.subtitle: Пошук нерухомості в Україні
uk-UA.description: Шукайте перевірені оголошення HataHub та оголошення HataHub Агрегатора про оренду та продаж нерухомості в Україні. Обирайте місто, тип нерухомості, ціну, валюту та кількість кімнат. Гортайте картки з фото, переглядайте характеристики та порівнюйте розташування на інтерактивній 3D-мапі в ChatGPT. Переходьте до оголошення на HataHub, щоб продовжити. Оголошення Агрегатора мають окрему позначку: особу та право власності не перевірено.
